raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Senior Analyst – Fund Accounting & Financial Reporting with 4.11 years of experience supporting end-to-end fund financial reporting processes across Private Equity, Real Estate, Hedge Funds, and Mutual Funds. Proven expertise in leading quarterly and annual financial statement close cycles (US GAAP/IFRS), preparing financial statement disclosures, workpaper review and sign-off, Big 4 audit execution, third-party service provider oversight, fee and waterfall calculations, and investor reporting — consistently delivering near-zero error-rate fund deliverables at HSBC. Experienced in owning workstreams, coaching junior team members, and driving efficiency through process improvement and automation. Proficient in Investran, Geneva, Bloomberg Terminal, CapIQ, Advanced Excel, Power BI, and SQL.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Analyst | HSBC Bengaluru, India
June 2022 – Present
Preparation of Financial Statements
Led end-to-end close-to-reporting execution for quarterly and annual fund financial reporting cycles across Private Equity, Real Estate, and Mutual Funds — aligning inputs from general ledger, portfolio operations, valuation, treasury, and fund administrators while managing calendars, dependencies, and cutoffs.
Independently prepared, reviewed, and signed off on financial statements, footnotes, and supporting schedules applying US GAAP
and IFRS standards across multi-jurisdiction fund structures including 40 Act and non-40 Act vehicles.
Reviewed and approved key workpapers and tie-outs — trial balance to financials, roll forwards, and lead schedules — ensuring
completeness, auditability, and consistent presentation across fund classes and share classes.
Prepared and reviewed financial statement disclosures covering investments, fair value, capital activity, related parties, and
commitments and contingencies — coordinating inputs and maintaining complete source support for each disclosure.
Financial Reporting
Served as the final quality gate for all fund deliverables — NAV packs, investor reports, and financial statements — before client
submission, maintaining a near-zero error rate across all reporting cycles.
Delivered period-over-period variance and trend analytics across fund portfolios, translating AUM, income, and expense drivers into
clear, leadership-ready narratives for senior stakeholders.
Coordinated regulatory reporting support by providing schedules and source data to internal tax and compliance teams and external
providers.
Led process documentation, controls, and quality reviews — checklists, sign-offs, and reconciliations — identifying gaps and
implementing remediation to reduce reporting risk.
Drove continuous improvement initiatives including standard templates, reconciliation automation, and workflow optimisation to
improve cycle time, reduce errors, and increase transparency.
Investor Services & Capital Activity
Managed the complete subscription and redemption cycle for Mutual Funds — including AML/KYC verification, unit allotment, and confirmation dispatch — maintaining accurate unit-holder register and investor records with zero errors on investor-facing documents.
Processed dividend declarations, income distributions, and reinvestment instructions, ensuring accurate unit-holder entitlements and
timely payment processing.
Sole reviewer for capital call notices, distribution waterfall calculations, and LP capital account statements across PE and Real
Estate funds — directly impacting investor trust and fund financial reporting integrity.
Supported and reviewed investor reporting packages — capital account statements, capital activity schedules, and performance
summaries — with a consistent zero-error rate.
Fee & Waterfall Calculations
Independently calculated and validated management fees, performance/incentive fees, carried interest (multi-tier waterfall structures
including preferred return, GP catch-up, and carry splits), TER, and fund expense allocations per LPA terms and prospectus.
Reviewed complex accounting activities impacting reporting — including capital calls, distributions, allocations, management and
performance fees, and expense allocations — ensuring accurate reflection in financial statements.
• Detected and corrected fee calculation errors prior to investor billing, preventing financial and reputational risk to the fund and the
firm.
Reconciliation & Exception Management
Led multi-system reconciliations between Investran/Geneva and portfolio records; conducted daily, monthly, and annual
reconciliations of fund holdings, cash balances, and trade data — resolving exceptions within defined SLA windows.
Performed trade and cash reconciliations between internal records and prime broker/custodian statements, ensuring zero
unresolved breaks ahead of period-end close.
Managed post-settlement exceptions and failed trade investigations, coordinating with counterparties and custodians to resolve
breaks within defined SLA windows.
Audit & Compliance
Directed audit execution including PBC coordination, walkthrough support, variance explanations, and evidence compilation —
anticipating auditor questions and driving timely closure of year-end and interim audits.
Oversaw third-party service provider deliverables from fund administrators, custodians, and valuation agents — resolving exceptions
through structured issue management and clear governance frameworks.
Supported preparation of regulatory filings and compliance reports, ensuring adherence to applicable regulatory requirements and
industry standards.
Transaction Processing & Portfolio Accounting
Executed daily transaction processing covering trade settlements, income and expense accruals, and corporate actions — ensuring
accuracy and compliance with fund guidelines across PE, Real Estate, and Mutual Fund portfolios.
Reviewed and posted investment transactions, corporate actions, income events, and fair value adjustments across the full
investment lifecycle, maintaining investment books and records (IBOR) integrity.
Provided day-to-day team leadership through work planning, coaching, and review feedback — escalating risks and issues early
while maintaining strong client and stakeholder communications.
Analyst – Trade Operations | Groww (Next Billion Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) Bengaluru, India • Managed end-to-end trade lifecycle across equities and derivatives including trade confirmation, validation, clearing, settlement, and
May 2021 – June 2022
reconciliation; minimised operational risk through on-time settlement across multiple instruments.
Developed MIS reports tracking trade volumes, settlement efficiency, pending exceptions, and KPI trends; monitored and maintained
data pipelines and dashboards to ensure accurate trade and operational data.

raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS & CORE COMPETENCIES
Financial Reporting
Fund Financial Reporting, US GAAP, IFRS, Financial Statement Preparation, Footnote Disclosures, Trial Balance Review, Workpaper Sign-off, Variance Analysis, Period-End Close, Close-to-Reporting Execution
Fund Accounting
NAV Calculation, Period-End Close, Fund Controllership, IBOR, Capital Activity, Management Fees, Performance Fees, Carried Interest, Waterfall Mechanics, TER, LPA Compliance, Fair Value Adjustments
Audit & Controls
Big 4 Audit Support, PBC Coordination, Audit Evidence Compilation, Walkthrough Support, Process Documentation, Control Gap Remediation, Quality Review
Investor Operations
Subscription & Redemption Processing, AML/KYC Compliance, Unit-Holder Register, Capital Call Notices, Distribution Waterfalls, LP Capital Account Statements, Investor Reporting
Reconciliation
Trade Settlement (T+1/T+2), Cash & Holdings Reconciliation, Exception Management, Custodian & Prime Broker Reconciliation, Post-Settlement Break Resolution, Multi-System Reconciliation
Systems & Tools
Investran, Geneva, Yardi, Paxus, Bloomberg Terminal, CapIQ, FactSet, Advanced Excel (Macros, Pivot, VLOOKUP), Power BI, SQL, MIS Reporting
Soft Skills
Workstream Ownership, Stakeholder Communication, Client Management, Team Mentoring, SLA Delivery, Process Improvement, Risk Escalation
